_readme: Fixed values the calculators use, each read on the official source cited below on retrieved_at. Weekly prices live in eia.json / latest.json (scripts/update-data.py, every Wednesday); state facts and the EIA winter forecast live in states.json and winter.json (scripts/build-states.py).

btu._basis: EIA, British thermal units (Btu) explained: heating oil 138,500 Btu per gallon, propane 91,452 Btu per gallon, electricity 3,412 Btu per kilowatthour.

propaneFill._basis: 29 CFR 1910.110(b)(12), Table H-27: an aboveground propane container of up to 1,200 gallons of water capacity may be filled to 42 % of the weight of water it holds when the gas has a specific gravity of 0.504 to 0.510 at 60 °F. Divided by that specific gravity, the liquid takes 82.4 % to 83.3 % of the tank's volume. The calculators start at 80 %, under that ceiling, and let the reader change it.

liheap._basis: 42 U.S.C. 8624(b)(2)(B): a household is eligible when its income does not exceed the greater of 150 % of the poverty level or 60 % of the state median income; a state may not exclude a household under 110 % of the poverty level on income alone. HHS 2026 poverty guidelines for the 48 contiguous states and DC: $15,960 for one person plus $5,680 per additional person. 60 % of state median income by household size: ACF LIHEAP IM 2026-01, Attachment 4 (FY2027, mandatory use), sizes 1 to 8 (45 CFR 96.85 factors 52, 68, 84, 100, 116, 132, 135 and 138 % of the four-person figure).

season._basis: EIA Heating Oil and Propane Update: weekly heating oil and propane prices are only collected during the heating season, October through March; prices are in dollars per gallon, excluding taxes, and the previous week may be revised. EIA Winter Fuels Outlook: winter covers November 1 through March 31.

efficiency._basis: ENERGY STAR, boilers: certified boilers have an annual fuel utilization efficiency (AFUE) of 87 % or more for oil and 90 % or more for gas (propane included). Electric resistance heat turns all its electricity into heat in the home.
